notes.title: Permanent Price Reduction
notes.content:
This is to announce our permanent price reduction of Space Jones VR on Steam. 
In order to let more players could experience this impressive space simulation VR game, we decide to reduce the price permanently. Have a great time with our game!

notes.title: 2 Weeks Special Deal for Space Jones VR!!!
notes.content:
Our first game Space Jones VR on Steam two months!!   To celebrate it we'd like to make it 30% OFF for two weeks. Hope more players could enjoy it.
Start from Oct. 17, 2016. Lets Rock!!
